reviews.title: Great quality fan, even better price
reviews.comment: Got two of the TL-C14C-S aRGB fans for the top  of my kids pc case to help keep it cool. If needed you can daisy chain these fan power and argb plugs which is nice. Cords are not very long which worked out perfectly for us but if you have a large case or few fan headers you will probably need some extension. None the less whisper quiet and move some air! The RGB is very clear and crisp but not overkill IMO. I will absolutely be stocking up on both 120mm and 140mm thermalright fans for my next build! For a 140mm aRGB fan that’s built and function how these do at $10 a pop you absolutely cannot beat it!
reviews.author: 907Hustler

reviews.title: Great quality and performance!!
reviews.comment: I recently purchased the Thermalright TL-C14C-S CPU Fan for a new gaming rig, and I couldn't be happier with its performance! The 140mm fan operates at a high speed of 1500RPM, providing excellent cooling for my CPU. Despite its high speed, it remains incredibly quiet thanks to the noise-reducing 7-blade design and soft silicone feet at the corners. I have the fan set on top for exhaust on my Thermaltake Tower 200. The PWM control allows for automatic speed adjustment based on the motherboard's temperature, ensuring optimal cooling without unnecessary noise. The build quality is top-notch, with a durable frame and ARGB cable for ease of installation. Installation was a breeze, and it fits perfectly in my case. Overall, this fan offers a fantastic combination of high performance and quiet operation, making it a must-have for any PC builder looking to keep their system cool and silent. Highly recommended!
